# Seeed Studio XIAO Series (CC BY-SA 4.0)

KiCad symbols and footprints for Seeed Studio's XIAO boards (nRF52840,
ESP32-C3/C5/C6/S3, RP2040, RP2350, SAMD21, MG24, RA4M1 and others), as
through-hole (DIP) and surface-mount (SMD) parts, and for add-on boards that
a XIAO plugs into.

- Publisher: Seeed Studio (Seeed Fusion Open Parts Library)
- Source: <https://github.com/Seeed-Studio/OPL_Kicad_Library>, folder
  `Seeed Studio XIAO Series Library`
- Revision: `b0035c51eb0348bb3e165fdb2f2765fa3d1d17bd` (2026-06-23)
- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International, see
  `LICENSE` (<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>)

## Changes

None to the contents. The footprints are moved into
`Seeed_Studio_XIAO_Series.pretty/`, the folder KiCad expects for the
nickname `Seeed_Studio_XIAO_Series`, which is the one the symbols' Footprint
fields already use.

## Note on the licence

CC BY-SA asks for attribution, and for adaptations of the library to be
shared under the same licence. Crossprobe credits the library in the
schematic and the build report of every design that uses one of its parts.
Unlike KiCad's own libraries, this licence has no exception that says a
design made with the library is not an adaptation of it. Whether a board
that uses these footprints must itself be shared alike is for the designer
to decide; the credit is there so that the question is not missed.

The 3D models the footprints point to (`${AMZPATH}/…`) are not part of the
library and are not included.
